label: Taiwan: Taitung zone to the east coast
why: Taitung's zone (tig, 1.29M) was the Central Range with both foothills, joined by shape across counties because the mountain townships fill the hull (T-2300). It keeps the east coast, Hualien and Taitung counties (0.45M). The west foothills go to the zone each mostly travels with (the merge rule's gravity) and its own county: Kaohsiung's hill districts and Pingtung's plain to Kaohsiung (which holds Pingtung City), Nantou's eleven townships (Puli, Zhushan) to Taichung (which holds Nantou City and Caotun), and Changhua's Ershui with them; Yunlin's east (Douliu, Dounan, Gukeng) to Huwei, making Yunlin one zone.
